Documented May 2025 border mockery of a trans traveller with no recourse, routine conversion therapy, censorship of queer expression, no protections or recognition; harassment-tier severity, but no criminalisation or patterned violence against trans people.

Police blackmail of LGBTQ people on apps, documented high stigma from law enforcement, attacks surging after propaganda laws, backsliding legislation banning recognition and care. No statute criminalises trans identity, but hostile institutions and thin recourse.

Constitutional SOGI protection, marriage equality, legal gender change, public trans healthcare, state-backed acceptance campaigns and annual pride. Police presentation crackdowns are two decades old with no record of recurrence; enforcement contested but institutions work.
